> Let's not forget the cultural dimension of Bayes: its cultural landmarks, the literary and musical traditions, and the art.

## Cultural landmarks

![](/culture/Bayes_tab.jpg){width="20%"} [Ashton Lodge](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ashton_Lodge), where Thomas Bayes lived 1734-1761.

![](/culture/Bayes_after.jpg){width="20%"} [Thomas Bayes' tomb](https://www.2bestsystems.com/foundation/restoration.htm)

![](/culture/bayescentre.jpg){width="20%"} [The Bayes Centre at University of Edinburgh](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UucsZDWbe8X6L1Gr7)

![Bayes cafe photo](/culture/bayescafe.jpg){width="20%"} [Bayes Cafe at University of Edinburgh](https://maps.app.goo.gl/HswG4RA7iJhrcea4A "Photo: Christian Robert")

## Music

The [Bayesian Songbook](https://mindstalk.net/bayesSongbook2006.pdf) contains the main gospels, often performed at the World Meetings in Bayesian Statistics. Some recorded songs from [Mark Glickman's Music webpage](https://www.glicko.net/music.html) are linked below, with Lyrics to help you sing along.
